content:
fern: short RFC follow-up: tenants reported model pins being unexpectedly short-lived when org/global pins exist with smaller leases. need a clear merge rule and a compact schema tweak.
li: saw the incident log. quick explanation: our merge currently picks min(lease_hours) across scopes which made a global 1h pin override tenant 72h.
omar: that's bad. users expect more-specific scope to win. propose simple rule: 'scope_priority' = tenant > workspace > org > global. server resolves final ttl accordingly.
nora: agree, but add one caveat: for long-running canaries we sometimes want older pins to fade. propose optional field "pin_staleness_policy": [KEEP_NEWER, KEEP_LONGER, SCOPE_PRIORITY]. default=SCOPE_PRIORITY.
fern: good idea. also add "entropy_score" (float 0-1) as advisory; server can apply a tunable factor to shrink ttl for high-entropy models. clients should read resolved_ttl when present.
li: add "resolution_reason" string to the resolved record so we can debug (e.g., "SCOPE_PRIORITY - tenant_override"). include counters for conflict_count in telemetry.
omar: migration sketch: 1) add optional fields to schema; 2) run background resolver in read-only to surface diffs; 3) dry-run backfill emitting resolution_reason metrics; 4) apply writes under feature-flag. roll back if resolved_ttl churn > X%.
ora: SDKs: accept new optional fields and expose helper builder that sets entropy_score from model-type heuristics. fallback: if resolved_ttl absent, compute lease_hours*(1-entropy_score).
ops-bot: note: schema additions are backward compatible, but control-plane must flag the change. schedule migration window and monitor resolved_ttl histogram.
fern: action items: fern write RFC update with examples; omar draft migration playbook; li add telemetry metrics; nora update SDK helpers. aiming to land in next sprint. :thumbsup:
